items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I would like to do a similar thing. I think it shows the age, the aging, but I think there is – as we were talking about Lady – a whole life in that voice. That’s something I’d like to come near to, if I could come near to that.

ctx.x: It’s a great thing. Are there any other things that you want to do, that you haven’t done?
Yes. I want to make an album. I’m not sure, one guitar or two guitars. But you know how Lady did – no, how Ella did an album with – Kimery: Joe Pass.

– with Joe Pass. I would like to do a similar thing. I think it shows the age, the aging, but I think there is – as we were talking about Lady – a whole life in that voice. That’s something I’d like to come near to, if I could come near to that. I think that would be a good thing.
